event.title: Andy Biggs Secures GOP Nomination for Arizona Governor
event.canonical_title: Andy Biggs Secures GOP Nomination for Arizona Governor
event.summary: Andy Biggs has won the Republican primary for Arizona governor, defeating fellow Representative David Schweikert. With this victory, Biggs will face incumbent Democratic Governor Katie Hobbs in the upcoming general election. The primaries are seen as pivotal in a state that is considered a key battleground for the fall elections.
